# INT-004 portable callable structural-mode negatives

This corpus carries the constructor-only negative pressure points from Matrix CALL-003 and CALL-017 at their competent callable structural layers.

- `manifest.tsv` owns stable fixture identity, portable verdict, competent layer, and exact Matrix/Certified authority.
- `captures-v1.tsv` records semantic capture occurrence, transfer, and structural mode without Haskell constructor identity.
- `mode-declarations-v1.tsv` records the explicit closure-mode declaration and any semantic justification independently of fixture identity.
- `authority-registry-v1.tsv` resolves every authority reference exactly and names checked-in Certified proof artifacts.

CALL-003 replay stops at closure-capture normalization. CALL-017 first reconstructs and successfully checks its capture summary, then reaches explicit closure-mode declaration checking; an earlier capture failure is therefore an unrelated failure and rejects the fixture harness itself.

Diagnostic strings and Haskell exception constructors are adapter details, not portable conformance authority.
